name: omawall
author: KiraYoshikage7777
description: Fast wallpaper engine and picker: photos, video and Wallpaper Engine workshop wallpapers, live desktop preview, effects, playlists. Light on weak laptops.

barWidget.description: Opens the wallpaper picker. Right click opens its settings.

schema.label: Power saver
schema.description: Lighter video and menu. Auto turns it on while on battery and on weak PCs.

schema.label: Keep wallpaper on close
schema.description: Closing the picker keeps the wallpaper you stopped on, no Enter needed.

schema.label: Desktop preview
schema.description: The wallpaper selected in the picker shows on the desktop at once.
